name: Chef au masque d’ivoire
description: A medium-built adult chief wearing a unique narrow ivory Yautja biomask with long angular cheek ridges and thin unlit eye slits; no human face. Dense black dreads decorated with polished bronze beads. Ceremonial black body armor beneath a cream sleeveless long coat, dark purple sash, delicate bone shoulder fan. Holds a crescent-ended short sceptre vertically in front with both hands, entirely in frame.
